name: Abstract Fonts · Ribel Noise

description.zh: 先看放大样张，再核对右侧作者、用途声明和包内许可文件。 按分类、作者和字母索引浏览的字体资源库，列表直接呈现不同字形，详情列作者、字形数、下载入口及包内文件。各字体有免费、个人用途等不同标记；平台整体授权未确认，须核对具体字体原作者和随包许可，下载文件尚未实取。
description.en: A font resource library browsable by category, designer, and alphabet. Lists show type specimens, while detail pages identify the designer, glyph count, download link, and package files. Individual fonts carry different free or personal-use labels. Platform-wide licensing is unverified; check the original designer and bundled license for each font. Downloaded files have not been obtained.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Abstract Fonts (https://www.abstractfonts.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 先看放大样张，再核对右侧作者、用途声明和包内许可文件。

Visual details from source observation: 我们在首页先看到 Ribel Noise 的粗笔刷字形，再往下是细长手写和厚重衬线样张。建议从 Categories 按字形挑一组，再开 Ribel Noise 看放大样张与右侧包内文件；页面列出字体和 OFL 文本入口。列表同时有免费与个人用途标记，不能把这一款的声明延伸到整站，下载前还要读原作者许可；本次没有取得字体文件。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
